name: memento
description: Agent-native workflow tooling: address PR review findings and carry a goal across a context reset.

plugins.name: memento
plugins.description: Address PR review findings with judgment (address-pr-reviews), write the handoff a future session wakes up with (message-in-a-bottle), enforce the context ceiling that makes writing it mandatory, and move or lift that ceiling for one session or for a whole project (ceiling), and show and move a session's own ceiling on cc-candybar's bar, through a plugin its hooks install.
